title: Free playable life sim (AI-assisted) — rent clock running
author: Fun-Tone-9333
selftext:
Dropping a free Windows playable if anyone here wants to poke at it.

LifeSim: one West Vine block, Monday morning, $200 in hand, $240 rent due in a week. 24 people on their own schedules. Same rules as you. Nothing scripted.

This download includes the housing capacity climb. Still one block — not the finished city.

AI disclosure (same as itch): AI Assisted — Code, Graphics, Sounds, Text. Not “fully AI-made,” no model-name hype.

https://durtedame.itch.io/lifesim
Install with the itch app (https://itch.io/app), then open from your library. A dedicated graphics card helps.

Curious what breaks first — rent, sleep, or finding work.
